title: Fix regression introduced by Apply-to-Oldest optimization
summary: The Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit was fixed to resolve a regression introduced by the Apply-to-Oldest optimization that affected application logic in general ledger posting.
key_points: Fixes regression in Apply-to-Oldest optimization with detailed issue tracking
Changes applied across all localization layers (W1, NA, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NO, RU, APAC)
Added 5 automated tests to cover the regression and validate performance optimization
Early-exit logic during summation preserved for performance
Low risk due to comprehensive test coverage
